annotations.title: Launch a product on Apptiller Launches

description: Launches an app (from its App Store link or id) or a website (its domain, plus a name) on Apptiller Launches, the public board ranked by the revenue a launch adds in its period, verified through the product's own RevenueCat app or its Stripe account and a TXT-verified domain (websites). It goes into the first open period with a spot (the founding month first). Returns the launch with its tier: verified (ranked), owner (ownership proven: listed, not ranked) or unverified, and what would raise it. One launch per product across Apptiller. Launching is free; it makes the product's name, tagline and launch-period numbers public.

hide_amounts.description: Show rank and growth only, never dollar amounts.

link.description: App Store link or id for an app; domain or URL for a website.

name.description: Required for a website; an app's defaults to its App Store name.

tagline.description: What it does, in one line.
